# Panos Kokmotos

> Panos Kokmotos is a Greek entrepreneur based in San Francisco and Athens — Forbes 30 Under 30 Greece 2024, WEF Global Shaper (San Francisco Hub), and Co-Founder & COO of Givelink, an in-kind donation platform that has impacted 100,000+ lives and processed $220K+ in donations across 100+ charity partners.

## Free AI Tools for Social Impact
A collection of free, no-signup AI tools for donors, volunteers, and nonprofits — listed at [ai-tools.html](https://panoskokmotos.com/ai-tools.html):
- [Donation Tax Estimator](https://panoskokmotos.com/donation-tax-estimator.html) — US & Greece tax savings calculator
- [What Would $X Do?](https://panoskokmotos.com/what-would-x-do.html) — Impact calculator for any donation amount
- [Why Should I Give?](https://panoskokmotos.com/why-should-i-give.html) — Personalized case for giving
- [First-Time Donor Coach](https://panoskokmotos.com/first-time-donor-coach.html) — 5-step giving plan for new donors
- [Charity Comparison Engine](https://panoskokmotos.com/charity-comparison-engine.html) — Compare org types by effectiveness
- [Nonprofit Health Checker](https://panoskokmotos.com/nonprofit-health-checker.html) — Health signals before you give
- [Scam Nonprofit Detector](https://panoskokmotos.com/scam-nonprofit-detector.html) — Fraud pattern screening
- [Volunteer Match](https://panoskokmotos.com/volunteer-match.html) — Skills-to-cause matching
- [What Can I Donate?](https://panoskokmotos.com/what-can-i-donate.html) — Household item to nonprofit matching
- [Impact Story Generator](https://panoskokmotos.com/impact-story-generator.html) — Before/after impact narratives
- [Community Needs Map](https://panoskokmotos.com/community-needs-map.html) — Ground-level need mapping
- [Neighborhood Giving Map](https://panoskokmotos.com/neighborhood-giving-map.html) — Local giving-flow analysis
